devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: {{count}} devices match the filters
devices.searchPlaceholder: Name, identity, IP, MAC, serial, model…

device.notFound: Device not found or not visible with your permissions.

issues.title: Open issues
issues.none: No open issue for this device.

monitor.noInterfaces: No monitored interface: choose them in “Interfaces and settings”.
monitor.errorsUnavailable: Errors and drops are available from agent 0.49.20 (delivered by the automatic update).

live.title: Live syslog
live.hint: Lines sent by the device to the NSM syslog server, refreshed every 5 seconds. Warnings and errors are kept for the device's whole life; info up to 3 months.
live.empty: No log received from this device.

access.title: Device logins
access.hint: Successful and failed logins found in the syslog, last 24 hours.
access.none: No failed attempt in the last 24 hours.
access.successes: Successful logins in the last 24 hours: {{count}}.
access.empty: No login recorded: the device syslog must include login messages (on RouterOS the “account” topic).

integrity.title: Log integrity
integrity.hint: Warnings, errors and critical lines are chained with a hash: a changed, inserted or deleted line breaks the chain.
integrity.anchored: Last anchor in the audit log {{when}}.
integrity.brokenAt: at line {{line}} received on {{when}}: the following lines may have been altered ({{count}} earlier lines checked).
integrity.noAnchorHint: The chain head recorded in the audit log is gone: the chain may have been rewritten.

setup.title: Syslog setup
setup.hint: NSM accepts only lines carrying the device key; every other line is discarded.
setup.noKey: not generated yet (open the manual setup)
setup.notConfirmed: key not confirmed yet: logs are discarded
setup.queued: The agent will configure syslog to {{remote}}:514 at the next heartbeat (within 2 minutes).
setup.already: A configuration is already queued: the agent receives it at the next heartbeat.

blocker.vendor: Automatic setup is available only with the MikroTik agent.
blocker.legacy: Legacy agent (RouterOS 7.12 or 6.x): use the manual setup.
blocker.legacy_readonly: Read-only legacy agent: reinstall it with a new token (legacy-ops-v1 profile) or use the manual setup.
blocker.legacy_version: A newer legacy agent is needed: reinstall it from the Agent tab or use the manual setup.
blocker.agent_version: A newer agent is needed: update it from the Agent tab.
blocker.no_target: Set the NSM IPv4 address reachable by the devices in Administration → Syslog.

backups.noPolicyHint: set up a policy in Backup

archive.title: Archive
archive.hint: Files of this device grouped by run. .rsc exports open and compare in the portal; binary backups can only be downloaded.
archive.empty: No backup archived: use “Back up now” or wait for the policy schedule.
archive.noFiles: No file archived for this run.

run.ready: Ready for an immediate backup through the agent.
run.queued: Backup queued: the agent runs it at the next heartbeat.
run.already: A backup is already queued or running.

blocker.vendor: Immediate agent backup is available for MikroTik; other devices follow their integration.
blocker.offline: The device must be online for an immediate backup.
blocker.no_agent: Complete the agent enrollment before backing up.
blocker.no_policy: No effective backup policy for this device.
blocker.pending: A backup is already queued or running.

verified.label: Agent verified
verified.detail: Pairing, credential and post-install heartbeat are verified.

stale.label: Heartbeat stale
stale.detail: Pairing is verified, but the device sends no recent heartbeat.

awaiting_heartbeat.label: Waiting for heartbeat
awaiting_heartbeat.detail: The credential was issued: waiting for the first heartbeat of the installed agent.

install_suspect.label: Agent not started
install_suspect.detail: The token was used and the credential exists, but no heartbeat arrived after pairing: check the RouterOS parser, scheduler and device log.

awaiting_pairing.label: Waiting for pairing
awaiting_pairing.detail: Valid one-shot token: the router has not used it yet.

token_expired.label: Token expired
token_expired.detail: Generate a new onboarding command and repeat the installation on the MikroTik.

verified_legacy_record.label: Agent working
verified_legacy_record.detail: Heartbeat and credential are valid; the original pairing history is not available.

credential_no_heartbeat.label: No heartbeat
credential_no_heartbeat.detail: The credential exists but no agent heartbeat has ever arrived.

not_enrolled.label: Agent not paired
not_enrolled.detail: No active agent credential: start or regenerate the onboarding.

pipeline.title: Installation check
pipeline.hint: Token created → one-shot pairing → per-device credential → heartbeat after installation. Pairing alone does not prove the script started.
pipeline.suspect: The token was used correctly ({{minutes}} minutes grace): the cause is in the script import or the RouterOS scheduler, not in authentication.

transport.title: Transport and pairing
transport.legacyNote: Legacy transport (RouterOS 6.48/6.49 and 7.12): heartbeat, telemetry, snapshots, diagnostics, reboot, RouterOS upgrade, syslog and FTP backup. On RouterOS 7.13+ the automatic update installs the modern agent.
transport.modernNote: Modern transport: every agent function enabled by the portal.

update.title: Agent update
update.hint: Agents that update themselves receive new versions automatically: the router downloads the script, RouterOS checks its syntax and the previous script is kept.

states.pending: Queued: arrives at the next heartbeat
states.awaiting_heartbeat: Installed: waiting for a heartbeat with the new version

update.drift: The script on the router differs from the expected one: the update realigns it.
update.toModern: On RouterOS 7.13+ the update installs the modern agent keeping its permissions.
update.toModernReinstall: On RouterOS 7.13+ reinstall the agent to switch to the modern transport.
update.reinstallDefault: This agent predates the automatic update.
update.reinstallHow: Use “Regenerate / reinstall agent” and paste the command on the router: after this, updates are automatic.
update.queued: Update queued: the router applies it at the next heartbeat, with automatic rollback on error.

credential.title: Agent credential
credential.hint: The permanent key is stored only as a hash and is never shown.

diagnostics.title: Remote diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Predefined read-only operations run by the agent: no shell or arbitrary RouterOS command comes from the cloud.
diagnostics.offline: The device is offline: diagnostics start when the agent is online.
diagnostics.noTraceroute: Traceroute is not available on RouterOS 6.
diagnostics.queued: Queued: the result arrives at the next heartbeat.

ping.title: Ping
ping.hint: Reachability and latency seen from the MikroTik.

traceroute.title: Traceroute
traceroute.hint: Path to the destination seen from the device.

dhcp_lookup.title: DHCP lookup
dhcp_lookup.hint: Find a lease by IPv4 or MAC.

logs.title: Device log
logs.hint: Warnings, errors and critical lines from the RouterOS buffer.

support_snapshot.title: Support snapshot
support_snapshot.hint: Resources, IPs, routes, interfaces, PPP, DHCP and log in one collection.

recent.title: Recent results
recent.hint: The latest 25 diagnostics: open a row for its details.

compliance.subtitle: Compliance controls per device.
compliance.evaluated: Evaluated {{devices}} devices: {{fail}} non-compliant, {{unknown}} without evidence, {{pass}} compliant.
compliance.noBaselines: No baseline defined: the default controls apply. Baselines are managed on the classic page.
compliance.legend: ✓ compliant · ✗ non-compliant · ? no evidence · E exception · – not applicable

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Investigations opened by operators, with the timeline of events recorded by NSM.

incidentDetail.notFound: Incident not found or outside your scope.
incidentDetail.unchanged: The incident already has this status.
incidentDetail.noRootCause: No confirmed cause: hypotheses stay to be verified until an operator confirms one.
incidentDetail.suggestionsHint: Hints computed from the timeline, not established facts. Record them as hypotheses to assess them.
incidentDetail.notePlaceholder: Supporting evidence (required to confirm or reject)
incidentDetail.truncated: Partial timeline: too many events for {{sources}}.

errors.note_in_future: The note cannot be in the future.
errors.foreign_devices: Devices must belong to the incident's customer.
errors.candidate_gone: The suggested correlation is no longer available.
errors.decision_note_required: State the evidence the decision is based on.
errors.invalid_resolved_at: Resolution must be after the start and not in the future.

auditEvents.title: Activity log
auditEvents.devicePlaceholder: Device: name, serial, MAC or IP

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Operational reports in PDF or CSV, archived with their SHA-256 fingerprint.
reports.generateHint: All customers or one, for a period of up to {{days}} days that does not end in the future.
reports.schedulesHint: Each schedule generates the report for the last closed period and sends it to the external recipients listed.
reports.confirmDelete: Delete the schedule “{{name}}”? Reports already archived remain available.
reports.archiveHint: Every download re-verifies the SHA-256 of the archived content.
reports.emptyCanGenerate: No archived reports: use the form above to generate the first one.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Users, roles, integrations and access to the platform.

adminUsers.passwordHint: The temporary password must meet the platform requirements (at least 12 characters).
adminUsers.scopeHelp: No selection = every customer. The user only sees devices, sites, incidents, reports and logs of the selected customers.
adminUsers.signedOut: Sessions closed: they will have to sign in again.
adminUsers.confirmReset: Reset two-step verification for {{name}}? Only when they lost their device.
adminUsers.failuresHelp: After {{pair}} failed attempts for the same user from the same address, or {{ip}} from the same address, within 15 minutes, new attempts are refused until the window ends. The account is not locked.
adminUsers.noFailures: No failed sign-ins in the last 24 hours.

roleHelp.admin: Full access: users, policies, integrations and settings.
roleHelp.technician: Devices, backups, firmware, remediation and technical operations.
roleHelp.operator: Read access, taking issues in charge and predefined operational jobs.
roleHelp.auditor: Read-only inventory, history, backups, CVEs and reports.

apiKeys.subtitle: Keys for the read-only public API: scope, expiry, rotation and revocation.
apiKeys.createHelp: The token is shown only once; the platform keeps only its fingerprint.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.tokenOnce: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe: it will not be shown again.

hints.neverUsed: Never used in {{count}} days: consider revoking it.
hints.idle: Unused for {{count}} days: consider revoking it.

apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{{name}}”? Requests using it will no longer be authorized.

scopeHelp.inventory.read: Customers and device inventory, read-only (always included).
scopeHelp.backup.read: Backup status and runs; no downloads or changes.
scopeHelp.firmware.read: Firmware status and recommended version, read-only.

system.subtitle: Platform status: version, worker, connectors, capacity, encryption, database backups and restore drills.

version.title: Version and database
version.lowDisk: Less than 10% free space on the backup volume ({{path}}): check retention or grow the disk.

worker.title: Worker
worker.help: The worker runs backup maintenance, firmware checks and reboots, UISP and advisory syncs, scheduled reports and compliance. Each task is isolated: one failure does not stop the others.
worker.noRedis: Redis unreachable: heartbeat and task state cannot be read.
worker.down: The worker has not answered for more than {{seconds}} seconds: scheduled backups, checks and syncs are stopped. Check ./manage.sh logs worker.
worker.noTasks: No task recorded: the worker has not started with this version yet.

connectors.title: Connectors and data sources
connectors.help: State of the sources NSM uses to observe devices and advisories.

capacity.title: Capacity and retention
capacity.help: Size of the database and of the backup archive, with the growth over the last 30 days.
capacity.filling_one: At the rate of the last 30 days the backup volume fills up in about {{count}} day: reduce policy retention or grow the disk.
capacity.filling_other: At the rate of the last 30 days the backup volume fills up in about {{count}} days: reduce policy retention or grow the disk.

notifications.rule_one: {{count}} day (failed ones stay until queued again)
notifications.rule_other: {{count}} days (failed ones stay until queued again)

backup_files.rule_one: according to the backup policy (daily, weekly, monthly)
backup_files.rule_other: according to the backup policy (daily, weekly, monthly)

evidence.data: Audit, jobs, snapshots, incidents, generated reports

secrets.title: Secret encryption
secrets.help: Connector credentials and MikroTik binary backup passwords are encrypted with ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY. Without that key .backup files cannot be opened: keep a copy off the host.
secrets.previous_one: {{count}} secret still uses a previous key: run ./manage.sh rotate-secrets, then remove ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS.
secrets.previous_other: {{count}} secrets still use a previous key: run ./manage.sh rotate-secrets, then remove ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS.
secrets.removePrevious_one: Every secret uses the current key: ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS ({{count}} key) can be removed. Keep previous keys together with dumps made before the rotation.
secrets.removePrevious_other: Every secret uses the current key: ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS ({{count}} keys) can be removed. Keep previous keys together with dumps made before the rotation.
secrets.unreadable_one: {{count}} secret cannot be read with any configured key: ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY was probably changed without listing the previous one in ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS.
secrets.unreadable_other: {{count}} secrets cannot be read with any configured key: ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY was probably changed without listing the previous one in ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS.

dumps.title: Platform database backups
dumps.help: Dumps created with ./manage.sh backup-db in {{folder}}. Schedule it at least every {{days}} days and copy the dumps off the host.
dumps.none: No database dump found. Without dumps customers, devices, history and configurations cannot be restored.

drills.title: Restore drills
drills.help: ./manage.sh restore-drill restores the last dump into a temporary database, checks it and drops it: the live database is not touched. Run a drill at least every {{days}} days. Full procedure: docs/OPERATIONS.md.

notificationsAdmin.subtitle: Channels NSM uses to send notifications and reports: e-mail, Telegram and Slack.
notificationsAdmin.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored one

smtp.title: E-mail server (SMTP)
smtp.help: Used for e-mail notifications and reports. The password is encrypted.
smtp.usernameHelp: Empty when the server needs no authentication.
smtp.saved: SMTP configuration saved; the password is encrypted.

health.title: Delivery status (24 hours)
health.help: A failed delivery is retried up to 6 times (after 1, 5, 15, 60 and 240 minutes); failed ones stay in the log and can be queued again.

chat.title: Telegram and Slack
chat.help: Telegram uses a single bot created with @BotFather; each user enters their chat ID in the profile (the bot replies with it to /start). Slack needs no setup: each user enters their channel webhook in the profile.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Data sources NSM uses to observe devices. The state shown is the connector's real state.

agent.title: MikroTik Agent
agent.help: Outbound agent installed on RouterOS routers: the router contacts NSM.

uisp.title: UISP Network
uisp.setup: Configure the URL and a read-only token to link Ubiquiti devices by MAC.

api.title: Public API
api.help: Read-only access for external systems with API keys and scopes: inventory, backups, vulnerabilities and firmware, confined per customer.

routeros.title: RouterOS catalogue
routeros.help: Latest versions per channel and release notes from upgrade.mikrotik.com; flags security updates even without a check from the router.

nvd.title: NVD advisories
nvd.help: CVEs from the National Vulnerability Database for RouterOS, matched with the installed versions.

genieacs.title: TR-069 / ACS (GenieACS)
genieacs.help: CPEs managed through GenieACS (ONTs, home routers), read-only from the NBI.
genieacs.limits: Diagnostics, backups and updates through the ACS are not available yet and are shown as not executable.

cnmaestro.title: cnMaestro (Cambium)
cnmaestro.help: Cambium radios (ePMP, PMP 450, cnPilot) read-only from cnMaestro: state, firmware, signal, SNR, throughput and history.

zabbix.title: Zabbix
zabbix.help: NSM pushes its devices to Zabbix (6.x and 7.x): hosts, groups per customer, templates per vendor, tags and inventory.

syslogAdmin.subtitle: Built-in syslog server: devices send warnings, errors and sign-ins; each device shows them in its Syslog tab.
syslogAdmin.noNetworks: No allowed networks configured: the receiver only accepts the addresses currently linked to devices. List your customers' and devices' networks (PPPoE pools, management networks) for stable protection.
syslogAdmin.receiverNote: UDP/TCP {{port}} in the container · last state {{seconds}} s ago
syslogAdmin.rejectedHelp: Lines that cannot be attributed with certainty to a device and its customer are discarded and not stored.
syslogAdmin.settingsHelp: Address to give the devices and log retention.
syslogAdmin.publicHostHelp: Public IP of this server (or reachable by the devices). Empty: the portal host name ({{host}}). RouterOS accepts only IP addresses.
syslogAdmin.retention: Retention of info, notice and debug (days)
syslogAdmin.retentionHelp: At most 90 days. Warning, error and critical lines are kept for the device's whole life.
syslogAdmin.networksHelp: One CIDR network per line. Packets from other networks are discarded before being read. Empty: only the addresses linked to devices.
syslogAdmin.keyOnly: Keyed lines only: each line must carry the device's NSM-… key (MikroTik prefix, Cisco origin-id or device name); lines without a key are always discarded.
syslogAdmin.autoConfigure: Configure syslog automatically on MikroTik devices with the agent: right when a new MikroTik is added and periodically on those already linked.
syslogAdmin.saved: Settings saved: the receiver applies them within a minute.
syslogAdmin.badNetworks: Invalid networks: {{networks}}. Use CIDR, for example 203.0.113.0/24.
syslogAdmin.configureAllHelp: The agent creates the “nsm” action and the critical, error, warning and account rules; other logging rules are left untouched.
syslogAdmin.configured: Configuration queued on {{queued}} MikroTik devices towards {{target}} ({{skipped}} not eligible or already in progress).
syslogAdmin.discardedHelp: Addresses that sent discarded lines: only the count and the reason are kept, not the content. To accept their logs, configure the key on the device (Syslog tab).
syslogAdmin.hardeningHelp: Measures active on the receiver, which is exposed to the Internet.
syslogAdmin.dbDedicated: dedicated (nsm_syslog): writes logs and reads devices only
syslogAdmin.dbMain: main account: run update.sh to create the dedicated user
syslogAdmin.containerHelp: read-only filesystem, non-root user, no capabilities, CPU/RAM/process limits, unneeded secrets removed
syslogAdmin.tlsOff: not active: mount certificate and key and set SYSLOG_TLS_CERT / SYSLOG_TLS_KEY (see OPERATIONS)
syslogAdmin.integrityHelp: hash chain on warning/error lines, anchored daily in the audit log
syslogAdmin.firewallHelp: Docker publishes port 514 bypassing ufw: these rules (DOCKER-USER chain) only let the allowed networks through. Apply them on the server with ./manage.sh syslog-firewall --apply and repeat after every network change.
syslogAdmin.vendors: Per-vendor instructions are on the classic page and in each device's Syslog tab:

reasons.strict: no key from a router in strict mode
reasons.ambiguous: IP shared by several devices, hostname not decisive
reasons.unknown: sender not linked to a device

nvd.title: Integrations · NVD
nvd.subtitle: Advisory source: CVEs published by the National Vulnerability Database for the tracked products, matched with the installed versions.
nvd.configHelp: Public, read-only use of the CVE 2.0 API. No NSM data is sent to NVD.
nvd.intervalHelp: After the first full load only the CVEs changed since the last update are read. On errors the next attempt is delayed progressively (up to 24 hours).
nvd.noKeyPlaceholder: Without a key: 5 requests every 30 seconds
nvd.keyStored: Key stored and encrypted, it cannot be read back from the interface.
nvd.keyHelp: Recommended only with many CVEs to read; the key is encrypted before it is stored.
nvd.tracked_one: {{count}} product tracked, derived from the devices in the inventory.
nvd.tracked_other: {{count}} products tracked, derived from the devices in the inventory.
nvd.lastRead: Last read: {{fetched}} records · {{created}} new · {{updated}} updated · {{unchanged}} unchanged · {{rejected}} rejected by NVD · {{errors}} not parseable.
nvd.matchingHelp: Recomputed after every update and every 15 minutes, so an updated device closes its own findings.
nvd.matched: Matches recomputed: {{opened}} opened, {{resolved}} resolved, {{unknown}} not assessable.

versionOnly.title: Version only
versionOnly.text: A device is flagged only when its installed version falls in the CVE ranges: never by vendor or product alone.

models.title: Specific models
models.text: When the CVE affects only some hardware models, the device model must match.

unknownRule.title: Not assessable
unknownRule.text: Unknown version or model, or CVEs without versions: listed in the CVE detail, not counted as exposed.

autoClose.title: Automatic closing
autoClose.text: When the installed version leaves the range the finding is resolved with the version as evidence.

nvd.coverageHelp: NSM queries NVD only for the vendors and models in the inventory. A device can be assessed when model and firmware version are known; the others are never considered exposed for their brand alone.
nvd.noCoverage: No device with a recognised vendor.

routeros.title: RouterOS catalogue
routeros.subtitle: Latest versions per channel read from upgrade.mikrotik.com every 6 hours. A release is marked “security” when its release notes mention security fixes; the lines are kept as evidence.
routeros.refreshed: {{channels}} channels read, {{releases}} new releases; {{updates}} devices with an update, {{security}} security.
routeros.emptyAdmin: Catalogue not read yet: use “Refresh now” or wait for the worker.

branding.subtitle: Platform identity: name, colours and logo, applied to both interfaces.
branding.identityHelp: Each colour can be customised or reset on its own.
branding.name: Platform name
branding.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP. At most 2 MB.
branding.appliesTo: Name, logo and colours show at once in the side menu of both interfaces.

errors.invalid_color: One of the colours is not valid.
errors.logo_size: The logo must be smaller than 2 MB.
errors.logo_type: Unsupported logo format. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.

acs.subtitle: Built-in TR-069 server (GenieACS): panel access, CPE setup and provisioning templates.
acs.panelAccess: NSM administrators only, then GenieACS login
acs.panelHelp: It opens in a new tab. NSM checks that you are an administrator; on first access GenieACS asks to create its own administrator and initial configuration (“init” procedure).
acs.linkHint: Link NSM to GenieACS with “Use built-in GenieACS” to see CPEs in NSM:
acs.guideHelp: Menus can change between models and firmware; TR-069 is mostly found on operator models (ONT XZ/XC, Archer VR/VX, some Archer C with ISP firmware).

cpe.title: On the CPE:
cpe.text: Advanced → System Tools → CWMP Settings (or TR-069): CWMP enabled; ACS URL {{url}}; ACS Username and Password empty for the first test, then set them; Periodic Inform enabled every 300 seconds; Connection Request Username and Password with your own credentials, used by GenieACS to contact the CPE.

network.title: Network:
network.text: the CPE must reach this server on port 7547/TCP. Connection requests (immediate actions from the ACS to the CPE) only work when the CPE is reachable; behind NAT changes apply at the next periodic inform.

templates.title: Templates:
templates.text: install the NSM base provisioning below. On first contact (BOOTSTRAP) and at every inform the CPE sets the inform to every 5 minutes and sends firmware, identity and WAN/PPPoE IP.

verify.title: Check in the ACS panel:
verify.text: the CPE appears in Devices with vendor, model and serial; any errors appear in Faults.

nsm.title: In NSM:
nsm.text: create the TP-Link device with its MAC or serial, open the device's ACS tab and link it to the CPE found in GenieACS.

security.auth: After the first test set CPE authentication in GenieACS: Admin → Config, key cwmp.auth (for example AUTH("acs-user", "long-password")) and the same credentials on every CPE.
security.network: Open port 7547 only towards customer networks and, if the CPE supports it, use HTTPS on the ACS.

acs.templatesHelp: In GenieACS a template is a provision (a script that reads and sets parameters) applied by a preset (when: events and a device condition). The button creates or updates NSM's; you can edit them or add others from the ACS panel.
acs.installed: Templates installed in GenieACS: {{items}}. Find them in the ACS panel under Admin → Provisions and Presets.
acs.notConnected: Link GenieACS first in Integrations → GenieACS (“Use built-in GenieACS” button).
acs.presetText: condition {{condition}}, bootstrap, boot and periodic events → provision {{provision}}

demo.subtitle: Isolated dataset to try the interface and workflows without using real customers.
demo.datasetHelp: Customers, sites, multi-vendor devices, policies, runs and downloadable fake backup files.
demo.inUse: Use them for search, moves, deletions, policies and backup downloads.
demo.clearHelp: Removes only objects identified as demo and the files in the demo backup folder.

cnmaestro.title: Integrations · cnMaestro
cnmaestro.subtitle: Read-only connector for Cambium radios (ePMP, PMP 450, cnPilot): linking by MAC or serial, state, firmware, IP and statistics every 15 minutes.

deviceExposure.helpAgent: The agent reads the active services and the firewall rules (input and raw) from the router configuration; NSM works out which are reachable from the Internet. No packet is sent to the device.
